# Data

------------------------------------------------------------------------

```{r}
# path to the data 
project_wd <- file.path(cfg$shared$cephalopod,"output/")
#FOLDER_NAME="official_com_class"
FOLDER_NAME="ZooTransparency"


# observations 
df_obs_all <- extract_observations(project_wd,FOLDER_NAME,
                                   SUBFOLDER_NAME="all")
df_obs_cop <- extract_observations(project_wd,FOLDER_NAME,
                                   SUBFOLDER_NAME="Copepoda")
df_obs_app <- extract_observations(project_wd,FOLDER_NAME,
                                   SUBFOLDER_NAME="Appendicularia")

# performance
perf_all <- extract_performance(project_wd,FOLDER_NAME,
                                SUBFOLDER_NAME="all")
perf_cop <- extract_performance(project_wd,FOLDER_NAME,
                                SUBFOLDER_NAME="Copepoda")
perf_app <- extract_performance(project_wd,FOLDER_NAME,
                                SUBFOLDER_NAME="Appendicularia")


# predictions
df_day_all <- extract_prediction(project_wd,FOLDER_NAME,
                                 SUBFOLDER_NAME="all",
                                 ensemble=TRUE,model=c("BRT","RF"),
                                 m=1:12,f=2)
df_day_cop <- extract_prediction(project_wd,FOLDER_NAME,
                                 SUBFOLDER_NAME="Copepoda",
                                 ensemble=TRUE,model=c("BRT","RF"),
                                 m=1:12,f=2)
df_day_app <- extract_prediction(project_wd,FOLDER_NAME,
                                 SUBFOLDER_NAME="Appendicularia",
                                 ensemble=TRUE,model=c("BRT","RF"),
                                 m=1:12,f=2)

df_night_all <- extract_prediction(project_wd,FOLDER_NAME,
                                 SUBFOLDER_NAME="all",
                                 ensemble=TRUE,model=c("BRT","RF"),
                                 m=1:12,f=1)
df_night_cop <- extract_prediction(project_wd,FOLDER_NAME,
                                 SUBFOLDER_NAME="Copepoda",
                                 ensemble=TRUE,model=c("BRT","RF"),
                                 m=1:12,f=1)
df_night_app <- extract_prediction(project_wd,FOLDER_NAME,
                                 SUBFOLDER_NAME="Appendicularia",
                                 ensemble=TRUE,model=c("BRT","RF"),
                                 m=1:12,f=1)

# land 
df_land <- extract_land(project_wd,FOLDER_NAME)
```

# Model performance

------------------------------------------------------------------------

```{r}
# plot performance for all models - combined metrics (threshold_size=0 removes it)
plot_performance(perf_all,plot_type="combined",title="Community")
plot_performance(perf_cop,plot_type="combined",title="Copepoda")
plot_performance(perf_app,plot_type="combined",title="Appendicularia")
```

# Predictions

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Limits for the transparency colorbars:

```{r}
# regular map of ensemble model (default: plot the predicted values with no uncertainty)
alllim <- round(quantile(df_day_all$predictedvalue,c(0.025,0.975),na.rm=TRUE)/5)*5
coplim <- round(quantile(df_day_cop$predictedvalue,c(0.025,0.975),na.rm=TRUE)/5)*5
applim <- round(quantile(df_day_app$predictedvalue,c(0.025,0.975),na.rm=TRUE)/5)*5
```

## Day

```{r}
# threshold: mean of standard deviations + standard deviation of standard deviations 
allthreshold=mean(df_day_all$predictedsd) + 1*sd(df_day_all$predictedsd)
allperc_below_threshold <- length(which(df_day_all$predictedsd < allthreshold))*100/nrow(df_day_all) # percentage of values below threshold 
copthreshold=mean(df_day_cop$predictedsd) + 1*sd(df_day_cop$predictedsd)
copperc_below_threshold <- length(which(df_day_cop$predictedsd < copthreshold))*100/nrow(df_day_cop) # percentage of values below threshold 
appthreshold=mean(df_day_app$predictedsd) + 1*sd(df_day_app$predictedsd)
appperc_below_threshold <- length(which(df_day_app$predictedsd < appthreshold))*100/nrow(df_day_app) # percentage of values below threshold 


# here xlab is used as the threshold label 
plot_all <- plot_prediction(output=df_day_all, 
                plot_uncertainty="stippling",uncertainty="predictedsd",
                ylim=c(170,190),
                xlab=paste0("sd > ", round(allthreshold,2), " (~ ", 100-round(allperc_below_threshold,1), "%)"),
                ylab="",
                threshold=allthreshold,
                ycolors=c("#000000", "#666666","#CCCCCC"),
                stippling_bin=2.5,stippling_size=0.5,stippling_color="red",
                correct.lightness=TRUE,
                latitude_profile=TRUE,legend_position="bottom",
                latitude_position="left",latitude_step=5,
                legend_adjust = -20)
plot_all

plot_cop <- plot_prediction(output=df_day_cop, 
                plot_uncertainty="stippling",uncertainty="predictedsd",
                ylim=c(170,190),
                xlab=paste0("sd > ", round(allthreshold,2), " (~ ", 100-round(allperc_below_threshold,1), "%)"),
                ylab="",
                threshold=allthreshold,
                ycolors=c("#000000", "#666666","#CCCCCC"),
                stippling_bin=2.5,stippling_size=0.5,stippling_color="red",
                correct.lightness=TRUE,
                latitude_profile=TRUE,legend_position="bottom",
                latitude_position="left",latitude_step=4)
plot_cop

plot_app <- plot_prediction(output=df_day_app, 
                plot_uncertainty="stippling",uncertainty="predictedsd",
                ylim=c(215,225),
                #ylim = applim,
                xlab=paste0("sd > ", round(appthreshold,2), " (~ ", 100-round(appperc_below_threshold,1), "%)"),
                ylab="",
                threshold=appthreshold,
                ycolors=c("#000000", "#666666","#CCCCCC"),
                stippling_bin=2.5,stippling_size=0.5,stippling_color="red",
                correct.lightness=TRUE,
                latitude_profile=TRUE,legend_position="bottom",
                latitude_position="left", latitude_step=3,
                colorbar_step=5)
plot_app
```

## Anomaly

```{r}
# threshold: mean of standard deviations + standard deviation of standard deviations 
allthreshold=mean(sqrt(df_night_all$predictedsd^2+df_day_all$predictedsd^2)) + 1*sd(sqrt(df_night_all$predictedsd^2+df_day_all$predictedsd^2))
allperc_below_threshold <- length(which(sqrt(df_night_all$predictedsd^2+df_day_all$predictedsd^2) < allthreshold))*100/nrow(df_day_all) # percentage of values below


anomaly_all <- plot_prediction(output=df_day_all, 
                plot_uncertainty="stippling",uncertainty="predictedsd",
                ylim=c(-4,4),
                xlab=paste0("sd > ", round(allthreshold,2), " (~ ", 100-round(allperc_below_threshold,1), "%)"),
                ylab="",
                threshold=allthreshold,
                ycolors=c("blue","white","red"),
                stippling_bin=2.5,stippling_size=0.5,stippling_color="black",
                anomaly=TRUE,anomaly_data=df_night_all,
                latitude_profile=TRUE,legend_position="bottom",
                latitude_position="right",latitude_step=0.5)
anomaly_all

copthreshold=mean(sqrt(df_night_cop$predictedsd^2+df_day_cop$predictedsd^2)) + 1*sd(sqrt(df_night_cop$predictedsd^2+df_day_cop$predictedsd^2))
copperc_below_threshold <- length(which(sqrt(df_night_cop$predictedsd^2+df_day_cop$predictedsd^2) < copthreshold))*100/nrow(df_day_cop) # percentage of values below


anomaly_cop <- plot_prediction(output=df_day_cop, 
                plot_uncertainty="stippling",uncertainty="predictedsd",
                ylim=c(-4,4),
                xlab=paste0("sd > ", round(copthreshold,2), " (~ ", 100-round(copperc_below_threshold,1), "%)"),
                ylab="",
                threshold=copthreshold,
                ycolors=c("blue","white","red"),
                stippling_bin=2.5,stippling_size=0.5,stippling_color="black",
                anomaly=TRUE,anomaly_data=df_night_cop,
                latitude_profile=TRUE,legend_position="bottom",
                latitude_position="right",latitude_step=1)
anomaly_cop

appthreshold=mean(sqrt(df_night_app$predictedsd^2+df_day_app$predictedsd^2)) + 1*sd(sqrt(df_night_app$predictedsd^2+df_day_app$predictedsd^2))
appperc_below_threshold <- length(which(sqrt(df_night_app$predictedsd^2+df_day_app$predictedsd^2) < appthreshold))*100/nrow(df_day_app) # percentage of values below


anomaly_app <- plot_prediction(output=df_day_app, 
                plot_uncertainty="stippling",uncertainty="predictedsd",
                ylim=c(-4,4),
                xlab=paste0("sd > ", round(appthreshold,2), " (~ ", 100-round(appperc_below_threshold,1), "%)"),
                ylab="",
                threshold=appthreshold,
                ycolors=c("blue","white","red"),
                stippling_bin=2.5,stippling_size=0.5,stippling_color="black",
                anomaly=TRUE,anomaly_data=df_night_app,
                latitude_profile=TRUE,legend_position="bottom",
                latitude_position="right",latitude_step=0.3)
anomaly_app
```

library(cowplot)
x=plot_grid(plot_all,anomaly_all, plot_cop, anomaly_cop, plot_app, anomaly_app,nrow=3,ncol=2)
x
